name: sixty-sh/sixty
description: Zero-config performance drift detection for PHP: Laravel, Symfony, and anything on PDO or MongoDB

suggest.ext-apcu: Aggregates windows across requests, so a busy service sends one payload per interval rather than one per request
suggest.ext-pdo: Measures SQL queries: rows returned, queries per request, query plans
suggest.ext-mongodb: Measures MongoDB commands: documents returned, round trips per cursor
suggest.doctrine/dbal: Measures Doctrine queries through a driver middleware (Symfony's default)
suggest.illuminate/support: Registers the Laravel service provider automatically
